entries.mechanism: Axiom and PolicyEngine use the current 2026 section 5822 indexation. Pinned TAXSIM's detailed 2024 state calculation reports a $5,112 exemption and $7,378 standard deduction (its internal pre-rounding parameters, versus the booklet's printed $5,100 and $7,400) and applies the official 3.35-percent first rate to the resulting $17,510 base.

Axiom and PolicyEngine use the current 2026 section 5822 indexation. Pinned TAXSIM's detailed 2024 state calculation reports a $5,112 exemption and $7,378 standard deduction and applies the official 3.35-percent first rate to the resulting $47,510 base.

Federal AGI equals $150,000, so section 5822's strict "exceeds" condition and the Axiom branch do not activate the minimum. PolicyEngine's inclusive SingleAmount threshold computes a $4,500 minimum at exactly $150,000, but its max still selects the $7,529.01 indexed schedule, so the selected target matches the statutory outcome. Pinned TAXSIM applies the official 2024 single thresholds to its detailed $137,510 taxable base after its internal $5,112 exemption and $7,378 standard deduction.

Axiom and PolicyEngine use the current 2026 section 5822 indexation. Pinned TAXSIM's detailed 2024 state calculation reports $10,224 of exemptions and a $14,806 joint standard deduction and applies the official 3.35-percent first rate to the resulting $34,970 base.

Axiom and PolicyEngine use the current 2026 section 5822 indexation. Pinned TAXSIM applies the official 2024 joint rates to its detailed $94,970 taxable base after $10,224 of exemptions and its $14,806 joint standard deduction.

Both years compare the schedule against the three-percent federal-AGI minimum ($9,000), and the schedule wins. Pinned TAXSIM reports a $274,970 taxable base from $10,224 of exemptions and its $14,806 joint standard deduction. The printed 2024 Schedule Y-1 reconstructs $16,365.92; TAXSIM's internal unrounded indexed threshold/base returns $16,365.84, an eight-cent implementation-rounding difference. The remaining residual is the 2024-to-2026 indexation vintage.
